EC2: Long-standing persistent [OR] or permanent atrial fibrillation.
EC5: Patient is unable to take warfarin [OR] or other oral anti-coagulant medication.
EC6: Patient is suffering with unstable angina in last one week.
EC7: Patient has had a myocardial infarction within last two months.
EC8: Patient is expecting or has had major cardiac surgery within last two months.
EC9: Patient is participating in a conflicting study.
EC10: Patient is unable to perform exercise testing.
EC11: Patient is mentally incapacitated and cannot consent or comply with follow-up.
EC12: Patient has New York Heart Association [AND] (NYHA) class III/IV heart failure.
EC13: Patient has left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) less than 35% not secondary to tachycardia.
EC15: Patient suffers with other cardiac rhythm disorders.
EC16: Recent coronary artery intervention or other factors suggesting clinical instability (ECG, clinical or laboratory findings).
